EMCH 101.description: Introduction to Mechanical Engineering; Engineering thinking; Problem-solving skills; University life and academic expectations.
EMCH 101.subject: EMCH
EMCH 101.title: Introduction to Mechanical Engineering

EMCH 111.description: Principles and practice of visualization and graphical representation using modern computer-aided design tools.
EMCH 111.subject: EMCH
EMCH 111.title: Introduction to Computer-Aided Design

EMCH 200.description: Principles of mechanics; Equilibrium of particles and rigid bodies; Distributed forces, centroids, and centers of gravity; Moments of inertia of areas; Analysis of simple structures and machines; Friction.
EMCH 200.subject: EMCH
EMCH 200.title: Statics

EMCH 201.description: Introduction and application of linear algebra and numerical methods to the solution of physical and engineering problems. Techniques include iterative solution techniques, methods of solving systems of equations, and numerical integration and differentiation.
EMCH 201.subject: EMCH
EMCH 201.title: Introduction to Applied Numerical Methods

EMCH 220.description: Introduction to the fundamentals of mechanical engineering for other engineering disciplines. Excluded: Mechanical Engineering Majors.
EMCH 220.subject: EMCH
EMCH 220.title: Mechanical Engineering Fundamentals for Non-Majors

EMCH 260.description: Study of forces and deformation in solids; Basic concepts of stress and strain; Elastic relations between stress and strain; Stress and strain transformations; Applications to mechanical components under axial, torsional, bending and pressure loads.
EMCH 260.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in EMCH 200 or ENCP 200.
EMCH 260.subject: EMCH
EMCH 260.title: Solid Mechanics

EMCH 290.description: Definitions, work, heat, and energy; First law of analyses of systems and control volumes; Second law analysis.
EMCH 290.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in PHYS 211; C or better in MATH 142.
EMCH 290.subject: EMCH
EMCH 290.title: Thermodynamics

EMCH 308.description: Introduction to stress analysis for beams, plates, shells, and solids using finite element based computer tools.
EMCH 308.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in EMCH 260 or ENCP 260.
EMCH 308.subject: EMCH
EMCH 308.title: Introduction to Finite Element Stress Analysis

EMCH 310.description: Kinematics of particles and rigid bodies; Kinetics of particles, emphasis on Newton's second law: energy and momentum methods for the solution of problems; Applications of plane motion of rigid bodies.
EMCH 310.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in MATH 242; C or better in EMCH 200 or ENCP 200.
EMCH 310.subject: EMCH
EMCH 310.title: Dynamics

EMCH 327.description: Design against static failure and fatigue failure of structural members and machine parts; Design and selection of components including: fasteners, welds, shafts, springs, gears, bearings, and chain drives.
EMCH 327.subject: EMCH
EMCH 327.title: Machine Design

EMCH 330.description: Analysis of forced and damped one-degree-of-freedom systems. Rotating unbalance and vibration isolation. Introduction to two-degrees-of-freedom systems.
EMCH 330.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: MATH 242 and either EMCH 310 or ENCP 210.
EMCH 330.subject: EMCH
EMCH 330.title: Mechanical Vibrations

EMCH 332.description: The application of vector and graphical analysis for the determination of positions, velocities and accelerations of planar linkages used in modern machinery.
EMCH 332.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in EMCH 310 or ENCP 210.
EMCH 332.subject: EMCH
EMCH 332.title: Kinematics

EMCH 354.description: One- and two-dimensional steady and transient heat conduction; Free and forced convection; Boiling and condensation; Radiation; Heat exchangers.
EMCH 354.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in EMCH 360 or AESP 265 or ENCP 360.
EMCH 354.subject: EMCH
EMCH 354.title: Heat Transfer

EMCH 360.description: Applications of fluid statics and dynamics; Conservation of mass, momentum, and energy; Similitude and dimensional analysis; Open channel flow, lift and drag; Introduction to turbulent flow
EMCH 360.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in EMCH 200 or ENCP 200 or BMEN 212; D or better in EMCH 290 or ENCP 290 or BMEN 290; C or better in MATH 242.
EMCH 360.subject: EMCH
EMCH 360.title: Fluid Mechanics

EMCH 361.description: Basic concepts of instruments, measurements, and experimental data analysis; Statistical analysis of experimental data and uncertainty analysis; LabView control, sensors, and measurement of parameters in mechanical engineering systems; Technical writing and presentation.
EMCH 361.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in EMCH 290, ENCP 290, or BMEN 290; D or better in EMCH 260 or ENCP 260; D or better in EMCH 201 or ENCP 201; D or better in ELCT 220 or ELCT 221.
EMCH 361.subject: EMCH
EMCH 361.title: Laboratory I

EMCH 362.description: Basic concepts of hypothesis, simple design of experiments to demonstrate principles and applications of fluid dynamics, manufacturing, mechanical properties, heat transfer, and vibration analysis through a series of lab experiments.
EMCH 362.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in EMCH 361.
EMCH 362.subject: EMCH
EMCH 362.title: Laboratory II

EMCH 363.description: Experiments directly related to advanced mechanical engineering courses. Physical and statistical design of experiments. Written and oral reports.
EMCH 363.subject: EMCH
EMCH 363.title: Mechanical Engineering Laboratory III

EMCH 367.description: Introduction to closed-loop control systems in Mechanical Engineering; Development of concepts, including transfer function, feedback, frequency response, and system stability; Programmable logic controllers (PLC); Control system design methods.
EMCH 367.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in EMCH 310 or ENCP 210.
EMCH 367.subject: EMCH
EMCH 367.title: Controls

EMCH 368.description: Introduction to the principles of integrating mechanical, electrical and computer engineering disciplines within a unified framework towards designing mechatronic systems; Fundamental overview of mechatronics (sensors, signals, actuators, microprocessors and models of mechatronic systems); Experimental exercises using microcontrollers.
EMCH 368.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in CSCE 106; D or better in ELCT 220 or ELCT 221.
EMCH 368.subject: EMCH
EMCH 368.title: Mechatronics

EMCH 371.description: An introduction to the relationships between chemical bonding, crystal structure, phase equilibria, microstructure, and properties of engineering materials.
EMCH 371.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in EMCH 260 or ENCP 260.
EMCH 371.subject: EMCH
EMCH 371.title: Materials

EMCH 377.description: Basics of: Deformative Manufacturing, Subtractive Manufacturing, Additive Manufacturing, Assembly Processes; Introduction to: Polymers Manufacturing, Composites Manufacturing, Computer-Aided Manufacturing.
EMCH 377.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in EMCH 371.
EMCH 377.subject: EMCH
EMCH 377.title: Manufacturing

EMCH 380.description: Introduction to decision making for engineering projects; Planning methods; Forecasting; Exploratory charts; Team building and leadership; Project scheduling; Project economics.
EMCH 380.subject: EMCH
EMCH 380.title: Project Management

EMCH 394.description: Basics of: Fundamentals of thermodynamics, Thermodynamic properties, Energy and Mass Conservation, Entropy and the Second Law Analysis; Introduction to: Power, Refrigeration, and Heat Pump Cycle Systems for vapor cycles and gas cycles; Application of Thermodynamic concepts to determine changes of enthalpy, entropy, and internal energy related with cycle systems, psychometrics, and combustion process.
EMCH 394.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in EMCH 290 or ENCP 290.
EMCH 394.subject: EMCH
EMCH 394.title: Applied Thermodynamics

EMCH 427.description: Open-ended design project initiation including: identifying and ranking customer and project needs, benchmarking appropriate design specifications, planning and project management, functional analysis, innovation and concept generation, learning through mockups, concept ranking and concept selection.
EMCH 427.subject: EMCH
EMCH 427.title: Design I

EMCH 428.description: Open-ended design project continuation including: identifying and performing relevant engineering analyses, parametric design refinement, project life cycle economic analysis, product/prototype construction, testing, and evaluation of the design; Consideration of safety, reliability, sustainability, and social impact.
EMCH 428.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in EMCH 427.
EMCH 428.subject: EMCH
EMCH 428.title: Design II

EMCH 441.description: Automotive engineering systems, descriptions, and associated operating and design principles. Past, present, and future automotive systems and components.
EMCH 441.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in EMCH 260 or ENCP 260, EMCH 394.
EMCH 441.subject: EMCH
EMCH 441.title: Automotive System Fundamentals

EMCH 460.description: Individual investigation or studies of special topics. A maximum of three credits may be applied toward a degree. Advance approval of project proposal by advisor and instructor.
EMCH 460.subject: EMCH
EMCH 460.title: Special Problems

EMCH 497.description: Methodology of design, mathematical modeling of thermal equipment, system simulation, system optimization using digital computer, and investment economics. Requires a semester-long design project. Two lectures and one problem session per week.
EMCH 497.subject: EMCH
EMCH 497.title: Design of Thermal Systems

EMCH 499.description: Preparation for the Fundamentals of Engineering Exam. Review general engineering and mechanical engineering-specific areas. Restricted to seniors. May not be used to satisfy program requirements.
EMCH 499.subject: EMCH
EMCH 499.title: Fundamentals of Engineering Preparation

EMCH 501.description: Engineering applications of solution techniques for ordinary and partial differential equations, including Sturm-Liouville theory, special functions, transform techniques, and numerical methods.
EMCH 501.subject: EMCH
EMCH 501.title: Engineering Analysis I

EMCH 502.description: Engineering applications of optimization methods, calculus of variations including approximate methods, and probability concepts.
EMCH 502.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in MATH 242.
EMCH 502.subject: EMCH
EMCH 502.title: Engineering Analysis II

EMCH 507.description: Solid modeling using commercial computer-aided design (CAD) applications package to reverse engineer-manufactured parts. Analytical curves and surfaces, transformation matrices, assembly modeling, and computer tools for analyzing parts and mechanisms.
EMCH 507.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in EMCH 201 or ENCP 201; D or better in EMCH 327.
EMCH 507.subject: EMCH
EMCH 507.title: Computer-Aided Design

EMCH 508.description: Development of the fundamental concepts of finite element modeling. Matrix equation assembly and reduction. Mechanical engineering applications in structures, stress analysis, ideal flow, and heat transfer problems.
EMCH 508.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in EMCH 201 or ENCP 201; D or better in EMCH 327.
EMCH 508.subject: EMCH
EMCH 508.title: Finite Element Analysis in Mechanical Engineering

EMCH 509.description: Optimizing computer-controlled machining processes, programmable logic controllers (PLCs), motion control of servomechanisms, CNC machining practices and programming, and robotics.
EMCH 509.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in MATH 241.
EMCH 509.subject: EMCH
EMCH 509.title: Computer-Aided Manufacturing

EMCH 514.description: Analysis and design of discrete-time control systems and implementation of control systems using digital electronic systems. Applications to electrical systems.
EMCH 514.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in EMCH 367 or ELCT 331 or equivalent.
EMCH 514.subject: EMCH
EMCH 514.title: Digital Control Systems

EMCH 515.description: Embedded electronics and software used in data acquisition, and process and instrument control in an industrial or manufacturing environment.
EMCH 515.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in EMCH 367 or ELCT 331 or equivalent.
EMCH 515.subject: EMCH
EMCH 515.title: Industrial Control

EMCH 516.description: An introduction to closed-loop control systems; development of concepts, including transfer function, feedback, frequency response, and system stability by examples taken from mechanical engineering practice; control system design methods.
EMCH 516.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in MATH 242; D or better in EMCH 330 or ENCP 330.
EMCH 516.subject: EMCH
EMCH 516.title: Control Theory in Mechanical Engineering

EMCH 520.description: Assessment of technological needs in the organization; coupling research and development to production; selection and evaluation of the technical project/program; technical planning, resource allocation, direction, and control; effective use and development of the engineering staff; the process of and barriers to technological change; technology, values, and policy. Senior or graduate standing.
EMCH 520.subject: EMCH
EMCH 520.title: Technology Planning

EMCH 521.description: A systematic approach to the mechanical design of products, requiring the concurrent design of all related processes.
EMCH 521.subject: EMCH
EMCH 521.title: Concurrent Engineering

EMCH 522.description: Product design principles for early consideration of issues to shorten product development time and to ensure smooth transition to manufacturing, thus accelerating time-to-market.
EMCH 522.subject: EMCH
EMCH 522.title: Design for Manufacture and Assembly

EMCH 527.description: Summary of mechanical design, project management, product liability and the law, intellectual property ethics and professionalism.
EMCH 527.subject: EMCH
EMCH 527.title: Design of Mechanical Systems

EMCH 528.description: Design considerations and methodologies for products to ensure adequate safeguards for the prevention of accidents, failures, and injuries. Senior standing.
EMCH 528.subject: EMCH
EMCH 528.title: Product Safety Engineering

EMCH 529.description: System design and development accomplished with consideration of environmental/ecological, economic, and social constraints. Students will be introduced to sustainable design and accomplish a design project. Senior standing.
EMCH 529.subject: EMCH
EMCH 529.title: Sustainable Design and Development

EMCH 530.description: Mathematical formulation of an optimum design problem, introduction to optimum design concepts and multidisciplinary design optimization. Use of mathematical programming methods for unconstrained and constrained minimization for engineering design optimization.
EMCH 530.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in MATH 142, Graduate standing.
EMCH 530.subject: EMCH
EMCH 530.title: Introduction to Engineering Optimization

EMCH 532.description: Kinematics and dynamics of particles and rigid bodies using Newtonian mechanics. Work/energy, impulse/momentum, 3-D motion.
EMCH 532.subject: EMCH
EMCH 532.title: Intermediate Dynamics

EMCH 535.description: Overview of robotics in practice and research: forward and inverse kinematics, statics and dynamics, trajectory generation, control, vision, and motion planning.
EMCH 535.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in EMCH 332 or department approval.
EMCH 535.subject: EMCH
EMCH 535.title: Robotics in Mechanical Engineering

EMCH 544.description: Application of the conservation laws of a compressible fluid to isentropic flows, flow with friction, and flows with heating or cooling. Shock and expansion waves. Nozzle and diffuser design.
EMCH 544.subject: EMCH
EMCH 544.title: Compressible Fluid Flow

EMCH 550.description: International nuclear non-proliferation programs and activities, proliferation risk assessment, and nuclear materials management and safeguards, including physical protection systems, material accounting and control, monitoring, and regulatory issues.
EMCH 550.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in CHEM 111, PHYS 211, MATH 241, MATH 242.
EMCH 550.subject: EMCH
EMCH 550.title: Introduction to Nuclear Safeguards

EMCH 552.description: Radioactivity and nuclear reactions; steady state and transient nuclear reactor theory.
EMCH 552.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in CHEM 111, PHYS 211, MATH 241, MATH 242.
EMCH 552.subject: EMCH
EMCH 552.title: Introduction to Nuclear Engineering

EMCH 553.description: Processing of nuclear fuel including fabrication, irradiation, and waste disposal or storage. In-core and out-of-core fuel management. Fuel cycle economics.
EMCH 553.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in CHEM 111, PHYS 211, MATH 241, MATH 242.
EMCH 553.subject: EMCH
EMCH 553.title: Nuclear Fuel Cycles

EMCH 554.description: Radiant heat exchange, combined modes of heat transfer, computer techniques in heat transfer analysis and design, environmental heat transfer.
EMCH 554.subject: EMCH
EMCH 554.title: Intermediate Heat Transfer

EMCH 555.description: Basic operational principles of radiation detection and nuclear instrumentation systems. Selection of the proper detector to measure radiation. Statistical analysis of results.
EMCH 555.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in CHEM 111, PHYS 211, MATH 241, MATH 242.
EMCH 555.subject: EMCH
EMCH 555.title: Instrumentation for Nuclear Engineering

EMCH 555L.description: Use of nuclear radiation detection and instrumentation systems and computers. Data acquisition and analysis.
EMCH 555L.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in CHEM 111, PHYS 211, MATH 241, MATH 242.
EMCH 555L.subject: EMCH
EMCH 555L.title: Nuclear Instrumentation Laboratory

EMCH 556.description: An introduction to probabilistic risk assessment (PRA) methods as applied to nuclear power plants but also examples from the chemical industry, aerospace, transportation, and other sectors. Addresses failure and reliability analysis, fault trees, event trees, reactor safety, regulatory practice.
EMCH 556.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in CHEM 111, PHYS 211, MATH 241, MATH 242.
EMCH 556.subject: EMCH
EMCH 556.title: Introduction to Risk Analysis and Reactor Safety

EMCH 557.description: Radiation interactions and transport, design of radiation shields, point kernel, and Monte Carlo methods. Dosimetry, buildup factors, radiation sources, and shield materials.
EMCH 557.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in CHEM 111, PHYS 211, MATH 241, MATH 242.
EMCH 557.subject: EMCH
EMCH 557.title: Introduction to Radiation Shielding and Sources

EMCH 558.description: PWR and BWR reactors, reactor system designs for accident prevention and mitigation, protection systems, containment design, emergency cooling requirements, code of federal regulations, and design criteria.
EMCH 558.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in CHEM 111, PHYS 211, MATH 241, MATH 242.
EMCH 558.subject: EMCH
EMCH 558.title: Introduction to Nuclear Reactor Systems

EMCH 560.description: Integral and differential analysis of fluids. Potential flow. Boundary layer analysis. Flow in closed and open channels. Flow dynamics of turbomachinery. Steady and unsteady flows.
EMCH 560.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in EMCH 310 or ENCP 210; D or better in EMCH 360 or ENCP 360.
EMCH 560.subject: EMCH
EMCH 560.title: Intermediate Fluid Mechanics

EMCH 561.description: Special topics related to current issues in mechanical engineering. Course content varies and will be announced in the schedule of classes by title.
EMCH 561.subject: EMCH
EMCH 561.title: Current Topics in Mechanical Engineering

EMCH 562.description: Basic fluid mechanics, capillary, drop and micro/nanoparticle, electrokinetics; micropump, mixer, preconcentrator, electrophoresis, microactuator and particle manipulator; sensors for pressure, velocity, concentration, temperature in environmental monitoring/biodefence, clinical diagnostics, drug discovery/delivery.
EMCH 562.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in CHEM 112 and CHEM112L or CHEM 142.
EMCH 562.subject: EMCH
EMCH 562.title: Micro/nanofluidics and Lab-on-a-Chip

EMCH 567.description: Fundamentals of nano- and microfabrication, metrology and their applications in biomedical engineering and science. The fabrication covers photolithography, nano/microfabrication for nano/microstructures, etching and additive techniques, MEMS integration and packaging, etc. Metrology focuses on characterization of nanostructures with imaging technologies.
EMCH 567.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in CHEM 112 and CHEM 112L or CHEM 142.
EMCH 567.subject: EMCH
EMCH 567.title: Bio Nano/Micro Electro-Mechanical Systems

EMCH 571.description: Micromechanisms of the deformation and fracture of structural materials; brittle versus ductile behavior; fatigue and creep; strengthening mechanisms; mechanical testing techniques; methods in analysis of mechanical failures.
EMCH 571.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in EMCH 260 or ENCP 260; D or better in EMCH 371.
EMCH 571.subject: EMCH
EMCH 571.title: Mechanical Behavior of Materials

EMCH 572.description: Equilibrium and phase relations in metallic systems; kinetics of phase transformations; annealing and precipitation phenomena.
EMCH 572.subject: EMCH
EMCH 572.title: Physical Metallurgy

EMCH 573.description: Materials for nuclear applications; materials degredation processes occuring in the nuclear reactor environment. Restricted to Engineering Upper Division and Graduate Students.
EMCH 573.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in EMCH 371, CHEM 111, PHYS 211, MATH 241, MATH 242.
EMCH 573.subject: EMCH
EMCH 573.title: Introduction to Nuclear Materials

EMCH 574.description: Introduction to the concepts of vibration and waves presented in a holistic approach including review of damped simple harmonic oscillator; sound waves; vibration and waves in a taut string; axial vibration and waves in a rod; flexural vibration and waves in a beam.
EMCH 574.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in MATH 241, MATH 242, and EMCH 310.
EMCH 574.subject: EMCH
EMCH 574.title: Vibration and Waves

EMCH 575.description: A multidisciplinary introductory course addressing the engineering field of adaptive materials and smart structures.
EMCH 575.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in EMCH 260 or ENCP 260; D or better in EMCH 310 or ENCP 210.
EMCH 575.subject: EMCH
EMCH 575.title: Adaptive Materials and Smart Structures

EMCH 576.description: Study of fuel cell principles, fuel cell characterization, characteristics of the major types of fuel cells, fuel cell and stack components, fuel cell stack and system design, fuel cell applications in portable, transportation, and stationary areas, as well as the current status and future research focus of fuel cells. Restricted to: Upper division.
EMCH 576.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: EMCH 290 or ECHE 310 or ENCP 290.
EMCH 576.subject: EMCH
EMCH 576.title: Fundamentals and Applications of Fuel Cells

EMCH 577.description: Static analysis of aerospace structural elements such as bars, beams, columns, plates, and shells. Topics include, but not limited to elasticity theory, simple beam theory, boundary value problems, and structural stability. Upper division or graduate status.
EMCH 577.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in EMCH 260 or ENCP 260; D or better in EMCH 310 or ENCP 210.
EMCH 577.subject: EMCH
EMCH 577.title: Aerospace Structures I

EMCH 578.description: Fundamentals of aerodynamics, elements of compressible flow, thin airfoil therory, finite wing theory, flow through nozzles diffusers and wind tunnels, normal and oblique shock waves, elements of the methods of characteristics of finite difference solutions for compressible flows, aspects of hypersonic flow.
EMCH 578.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in AESP 265; D or better in ENCP 360 or EMCH 360.
EMCH 578.subject: EMCH
EMCH 578.title: Introduction to Aerodynamics

EMCH 580.description: Introduction to the mechanical behavior of solid biomaterials. Structure and mechanical properties of tissue including skin, myocardium, and tendon. Mathematical treatment of anisotropic elasticity, nonlinear elasticity, linear and quasi-linear viscoelasticity, muscle activity.
EMCH 580.subject: EMCH
EMCH 580.title: Mechanics of Solid Biomaterials

EMCH 584.description: Topics in stress analysis, including unsymmetrical bending, three-dimensional stress-strain; torsion; rotational stress; thick-walled pressure vessels; beams on elastic foundations; and stress concentration.
EMCH 584.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in EMCH 260 or ENCP 260.
EMCH 584.subject: EMCH
EMCH 584.title: Advanced Mechanics of Materials

EMCH 585.description: Introduction to fiber reinforced polymer (FRP) composite materials, manufacturing methods and processes. Micro-Mechanics and properties of orthotropic laminated and woven composites. Analysis of composite structures (Mechanics and Synergistic environmental effects). Structure/property relationships. Characterization of modern composite materials. Design considerations.
EMCH 585.subject: EMCH
EMCH 585.title: Introduction to Composite Materials

EMCH 586.description: Stress analysis utilizing experimental techniques including transmission and scattered light photoelasticity, strain gauges, and brittle coatings. Introduction to modern concepts of coherent optics in stress analysis with emphasis on engineering applications.
EMCH 586.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in EMCH 260 or ENCP 260.
EMCH 586.subject: EMCH
EMCH 586.title: Experimental Stress Analysis

EMCH 592.description: Chemical thermodynamics, reaction kinetics, and combustion phenomena in energy production. Application to the modeling of coal combustion, incineration, and combustion engines.
EMCH 592.subject: EMCH
EMCH 592.title: Introduction to Combustion

EMCH 594.description: Solar radiation; review of heat transfer and radiation characteristics of relevant materials; flat plate and focusing collectors; energy storage models for design of solar heating systems; system design by computer simulation; direct conversion by solar cells.
EMCH 594.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in EMCH 290, ENCP 290, EMCH 354, or ECHE 321.
EMCH 594.subject: EMCH
EMCH 594.title: Solar Heating

EMCH 597.description: Vapor compression and absorption refrigeration systems. Heat pumps. Properties of refrigerants. Cryogenic refrigeration. Heating and cooling of buildings. Solar heating and cooling systems.
EMCH 597.subject: EMCH
EMCH 597.title: Thermal Environmental Engineering

EMCH 701.description: Variational methods of approximation are used with the finite element method to simulate the reliability predictions in design of mechanical systems. The functional relationship between geometry, materials, and physical laws of motion and energy are applied to solid, thermal, and fluid systems.
EMCH 701.subject: EMCH
EMCH 701.title: Methods of Engineering Analysis

EMCH 708.description: Integration of computer-aided design and computer-aided engineering for shorter design cycles. Application of solid modeling and computer simulation tools to the design process.
EMCH 708.subject: EMCH
EMCH 708.title: Computer-Aided Product Design and Analysis

EMCH 717.description: Advanced finite element topics, including dynamic and nonlinear analyses. Computer projects will be assigned.
EMCH 717.subject: EMCH
EMCH 717.title: Advanced Finite Element Methods

EMCH 721.description: Study the principles and applications of aircraft aeroelasticity with emphasis on aircraft structural dynamics, vibrations, unsteady aerodynamics, and interaction thereof.
EMCH 721.subject: EMCH
EMCH 721.title: Aeroelasticity

EMCH 722.description: Basic experiments and observations of elastic-plastic material behavior; yield criteria; deformation and flow theories; slip line fields; numerical techniques; one and two dimensional applications.
EMCH 722.subject: EMCH
EMCH 722.title: Plasticity

EMCH 727.description: Analysis of stresses involved in mechanical loading under various environmental conditions including failure criteria, impact and fatigue loading, residual stress, contact stress, and experimental stress analysis.
EMCH 727.subject: EMCH
EMCH 727.title: Advanced Mechanical Design

EMCH 732.description: Rigid body dynamics of mechanical systems. Dynamics of linkages, gears, and cams. Balancing. Synthesis of mechanisms. Digital computer and computer graphics methods in dynamics.
EMCH 732.subject: EMCH
EMCH 732.title: Advanced Dynamics of Machinery

EMCH 741.description: Viscosity. The Navier-Stokes equation, its formulation and its properties. Exact solutions of the flow at low Reynolds number. Flow at high Reynolds number. The momentum theory of boundary layer. Turbulent flows.
EMCH 741.subject: EMCH
EMCH 741.title: Viscous and Turbulent Flow

EMCH 742.description: Development of the general equations of frictionless flow. Small perturbation theory. Subsonic and supersonic similarity rules. Applications of the method of characteristics to unsteady flow. Low density flow fundamentals.
EMCH 742.subject: EMCH
EMCH 742.title: Advanced Gas Dynamics

EMCH 743.description: Introduction to aircraft and rocket engines with emphasis on the performance and characteristics of various types of propulsion systems, including turbojet, turbofan, turboprop, ramjet, scramjet, and liquid and solid propellant rockets.
EMCH 743.subject: EMCH
EMCH 743.title: Aircraft and Rocket Propulsion

EMCH 744.description: Aerodynamics of wings and bodies in aircraft and the static and dynamic analysis of airplane flight mechanics. Topics include fundamentals of potential flows, thin airfoil theory, finite wing theory, laminar and turbulent boundary layers, trajectory analysis, and stability and control of an airplane.
EMCH 744.subject: EMCH
EMCH 744.title: Aerodynamics Flight Mechanics

EMCH 745.description: Numerical approach of solving fluid flow and heat transfer problem; partial differential equations. Discretization methods, finite differences, finite volume methods. Numerical properties of discretization schemes. Diffusive transport, convective transport, waves and oscillations. Scalar representation of the Navier-Stokes equations; incompressible Navier-Stokes solvers.
EMCH 745.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in EMCH 354 and C or better in EMCH 201 or ENCP 201.
EMCH 745.subject: EMCH
EMCH 745.title: Computational Fluid Dynamics and Heat Transfer

EMCH 751.description: Development of the energy equation for convection and some exact solutions. Approximate analysis of the boundary layer by integral methods. Analogy between heat and momentum transfer. Experimental results.
EMCH 751.subject: EMCH
EMCH 751.title: Advanced Heat Transfer

EMCH 752.description: Radiation heat transfer between surfaces of enclosures; diffuse-gray and nondiffuse-gray surfaces. Radiative properties of real materials; metals, opaque nonmetals, transmitting solids. Gas radiation in enclosures.
EMCH 752.subject: EMCH
EMCH 752.title: Thermal Radiation Heat Transfer

EMCH 753.description: Principles of chemical thermodynamics; reactions, transformations, phase equilibria, and applications to engineering processes.
EMCH 753.subject: EMCH
EMCH 753.title: Chemical Thermodynamic Calculations and Modeling with Applications

EMCH 754.description: Power plant thermodynamics, reactor heat generation and removal (single-phase as well as two-phase coolant flow and heat transfer), and engineering considerations in reactor design.
EMCH 754.subject: EMCH
EMCH 754.title: Thermal Hydraulic Design of Nuclear Reactors

EMCH 755.description: Reactor physics including heterogeneous effects, multi-group calculations, reactor kinetics, stability and control, fuel depletion, and burnable poisons.
EMCH 755.subject: EMCH
EMCH 755.title: Advanced Nuclear Engineering

EMCH 756.description: Analysis of the safety of nuclear energy facilities focusing on reliability and probabilistic risk analysis.
EMCH 756.subject: EMCH
EMCH 756.title: Safety Analysis for Energy Systems

EMCH 757.description: Radiation interactions and transport, design of radiation shields, point kernel, removal-diffusion, discrete ordinates, and Monte Carlo methods. Dosimetry, buildup factors, radiation sources, and shield materials.
EMCH 757.subject: EMCH
EMCH 757.title: Radiation Shielding

EMCH 758.description: PWR and BWR reactors, reactor system designs for accident prevention and mitigation, protection systems, containment design, emergency cooling requirements, and atmospheric dispersion of radioactive material.
EMCH 758.subject: EMCH
EMCH 758.title: Nuclear Reactor Systems

EMCH 759.description: Management of low- and high-level radioactive, hazardous, and mixed waste; transportation, treatment, storage, and disposal techniques. Political and social issues involved with nuclear waste.
EMCH 759.subject: EMCH
EMCH 759.title: Waste Management in the Nuclear Industry

EMCH 764.description: Guided independent work on current research or design projects, culminating either in a written report or in the construction of a prototype device.
EMCH 764.subject: EMCH
EMCH 764.title: Mechanical Engineering Projects

EMCH 767.description: Fundamentals of micromachining and microfabrication technologies, microsystem design, MEMS integration and packaging issues, design and analysis of microsensors and microactuators, microfluidics and bioMEMS, and CAD for MEMS. Design project required.
EMCH 767.subject: EMCH
EMCH 767.title: Microelectromechanical Systems (MEMS)

EMCH 770.description: Experimental and computational uncertainties; combining experiments with computations to obtain best - estimate results with reduced uncertainties; predictive modeling.
EMCH 770.subject: EMCH
EMCH 770.title: Predictive Modeling: Combining Experiments with Computations

EMCH 771.description: Physical properties of various commercial thermoset and thermoplastic resins. Linear viscoelestic theory and its relationship to measurable mechanical properties of plastics.
EMCH 771.subject: EMCH
EMCH 771.title: Design Properties of Plastics

EMCH 772.description: This course focuses on behavior and performance of materials in nuclear irradiation fields. Materials used in the core for reactivity control and materials used for structural support will be studied.
EMCH 772.subject: EMCH
EMCH 772.title: Nuclear Materials

EMCH 774.description: Structural materials for nuclear application; Radiation interaction with matter; Microstructure evolution under irradiation; Material properties degradation under irradation.
EMCH 774.subject: EMCH
EMCH 774.title: Radiation Damage

EMCH 777.description: Principles and applications of aerospace structures with emphasis on the construction and analysis of thin-wall monocoque and semi-monocoque wings and fuselages.
EMCH 777.subject: EMCH
EMCH 777.title: Aerospace Structures II

EMCH 778.description: Advances in nanomaterials; synthesis of nanomaterials; nanoparticles, nanotubes/wires, nanometer thick thin films, nanostructured bulk materials; assembly of nanostructures; biologically inspired structures; structure-property-correlations in nanomaterials and nanostructures; advanced characterization techniques; applications, especially those related to nanotechnology, information technology, MEMS/NEMS, and biotechnology.
EMCH 778.subject: EMCH
EMCH 778.title: Nanomaterials: Synthesis, Characterization, and Applications

EMCH 780.description: This course is aimed to provide graduate students with a comprehensive introduction to the various energy storage mechanisms and technologies that are currently being utilized. The content of the course includes methods and mechanisms of common energy storage (thermal, mechanical, chemical and electrochemical).
EMCH 780.subject: EMCH
EMCH 780.title: Energy Storage

EMCH 785.description: Property and performance requirements for aerospace structures. Design for stiffness, strength, durability, damage tolerance, and life at the lamina, laminate, and structural level (materials and analysis).
EMCH 785.subject: EMCH
EMCH 785.title: Design of Composite Materials for Aerospace Structures

EMCH 790.description: Introduction to concepts of modeling, dimensional analysis, lift, and drag. For preservice teachers enrolled in a professional program (M.A.T. and M.T. students) and in-service teachers (M.Ed. and Ed.S. students) only.
EMCH 790.subject: EMCH
EMCH 790.title: Mechanical Engineering for Teachers I

EMCH 791.description: Special topics related to current research in thermal systems.
EMCH 791.subject: EMCH
EMCH 791.title: Selected Topics in Thermal Systems

EMCH 792.description: Special topics related to current research in mechanical systems.
EMCH 792.subject: EMCH
EMCH 792.title: Selected Topics in Mechanical Systems

EMCH 793.description: Development of the physics of turbulent flow, turbulent combustion, atomization, and vaporization of liquid sprays. Design and analysis of industrial combustion processes including incinerators and furnaces.
EMCH 793.subject: EMCH
EMCH 793.title: Combustion Processes in Industry

EMCH 794.description: An advanced treatment of thermodynamics stressing fundamentals. Application of first and second laws; study of properties and criteria for reactive, non-reactive, and coupled systems.
EMCH 794.subject: EMCH
EMCH 794.title: Thermodynamics

EMCH 847.description: Hydrodynamics of one and two-phase flow in ducts. Pressure surges and flow stability. Flow induced vibrations. Numerical techniques. Fluid power systems design.
EMCH 847.subject: EMCH
EMCH 847.title: Fluid Systems Design

EMCH 857.description: Solution of radiation problems through non-absorbing, non-emitting media. Heat exchanger design.
EMCH 857.subject: EMCH
EMCH 857.title: Advanced Heat Transfer II

EMCH 881.description: Fatigue of materials presented from mechanics and microstructural points of view. Stress-life, strain life, and Linear Elastic Fracture Mechanics (LEFM) approaches will be covered.
EMCH 881.subject: EMCH
EMCH 881.title: Fatigue of Materials

EMCH 882.description: Linear elastic and elastoplastic description of stress fields around cracks. Discussion of stress intensity factor, strain energy density. Dynamic crack propagation and arrest. Fatigue crack propagation. Fracture toughness testing. Applications of concepts.
EMCH 882.subject: EMCH
EMCH 882.title: Fracture Mechanics

EMCH 883.description: Formulation and solution of the wave propagation problem in an unbounded isotropic medium. Study of the reflection-refraction problem at a plane interface. Discussion of Rayleigh, Love, and general surface waves. Wave propagation in a bounded isotropic medium.
EMCH 883.subject: EMCH
EMCH 883.title: Wave Propagation in Solids
